description: Client exceeds per-user/org rate limit (APIM burst protection or Stage 5.5 per-user request-rate limit) — rejected before a quota reservation or provider call is made.

events.message: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

note: requestId is null because this is rejected before request.accepted — no inference_requests row is created for a rate-limited call rejected at the edge. If APIM rejects it, the response is a REST 429 with the same ErrorCode body (Docs/contracts/openapi.yaml), not an SSE stream at all; this fixture represents the case where the API layer itself rejects after the stream has started to open but before request.accepted.
expectedLedgerOutcome: No inference_requests row, no quota_reservation, no usage_ledger entry — nothing to reconcile.
expectedClientOutcome: Preview shows 'Too many requests, try again shortly'; the client must back off rather than immediately retrying with a new operationId.
